ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white fields dominate the distal and mid-lobe regions; low-intensity black pixels form dense irregular borders along the trailing edge and radiate from the median notch in a dendritic pattern.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; depth is approximately 15-20% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated boundary with frequent jagged peaks; amplitude of serrations increases toward the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a slight convex curve towards the tips; leading edges visible at the margins are smoothly convex.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast white calcified points at both lateral tips; several small circular dark focal spots on the mid-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Long vertical dark scratch on the right lobe; shorter rake-like marks on the inner left lobe near the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle infestation at the lateral tips; yellowish-brown organic staining across the central white surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct 'V' shaped black pigmentation island at the base of the notch.
